items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: She worked out with Nat Cole and Eddie Cole at a place called the Panama.

ctx.x: She worked out with Nat Cole and Eddie Cole at a place called the Panama. You know, the great Nat Cole and Eddie Cole were at a place called the Panama. But the first time I heard her name, you know Roy is always a very forward person. He's my buddy all the way.
